question: I am switching from another insurer. Will my 3 years of waiting period carry over if I increase my sum insured?
answer: Waiting periods already served with your previous insurer will carry over, but only up to the sum insured of your previous policy, including any accrued no-claim bonus [1][2]. Any increase in the sum insured will be subject to fresh waiting periods on the incremental amount [1][2].

question: Is knee replacement covered immediately after I buy the policy?
answer: Knee joint replacement is generally not covered immediately, as it is subject to a 24-month waiting period [2][3]. However, if the knee replacement is required following an accidental injury, it is covered from day one with no waiting period [2][3].
